description: Single-VM scenario delivering the Nextcloud docker-compose stack (postgres + redis + nextcloud + provisioner) on admin-nextcloud-standalone (VMID 1181, IP 192.168.142.181, vmbr142) via the shared bundle bundles/admin/software.install.nextcloud/, against the catalog element range42-catalog/03_container_layer/docker/admin/nextcloud/. Nextcloud is modeled as an admin-tier service gated by INSTALL_NEXTCLOUD (default YES - nextcloud_lab is the Nextcloud showcase scenario). Template VMID 9232 (template-vm-medium-02-8g-64g, 2cpu/8gb/64gb) is built by this scenario's 01_templates-bootstrap/ (idempotent : skipped if already present from another scenario such as blank_scenario_2_subnets, demo_lab, misp_lab, or mattermost_lab).
